name: io.github.ciltress/skyrim-modding-tools-mcp
title: Skyrim Modding Tools
description: Skyrim SE modding: look up records in a Mod Organizer load order, author mods and patches as text

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which tools are listed and callable: core (the smallest set that can read and change something, for small local models), readonly (never writes), or all. A tool outside the profile cannot be called.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on one tool answer, in bytes; 0 removes it. Defaults to the profile's: core 24000, readonly 32000, all none. An answer over it is replaced by valid JSON naming the next step.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to skip asking the backend which optional features it supports. With it on, tools the backend cannot serve are withheld from tools/list.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (the default) for one client that starts this process, or http to serve Streamable HTTP at /mcp for many, each with its own bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to listen on in HTTP mode.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address to bind in HTTP mode. Use 127.0.0.1 to serve this machine only.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Browser origins allowed to call /mcp in HTTP mode, comma-separated; * allows any. Empty serves none. MCP clients that are not web pages send no Origin and are unaffected.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Host header values answered to in HTTP mode, comma-separated. Empty accepts any; set it to the published name as a DNS-rebinding guard.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Requests per minute per session in HTTP mode, as a token bucket. 0 turns it off.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_MOD_MANAGER
environmentVariables.description: The mod manager that keeps the mods: mo2 (Mod Organizer 2, on Windows or under Proton) or amethyst (Amethyst Mod Manager on Linux). Found by itself: Mod Organizer when SKYRIM_MO2_INSTANCE is set, else Amethyst when it has Skyrim set up.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_MO2_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Required with Mod Organizer (SKYRIM_MOD_MANAGER=mo2, the default): the instance folder holding ModOrganizer.exe and ModOrganizer.ini. The server follows whichever profile Mod Organizer has selected.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_WINE_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: With Mod Organizer under Proton on Linux: the Wine prefix it runs in (the folder with dosdevices in it), to read the Windows paths in ModOrganizer.ini. Found by itself for an MO2-LINT install; without one, only paths on Z: are read.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_AMETHYST_DIR
environmentVariables.description: With Amethyst: its config folder (…/AmethystModManager). Found by itself in the Flatpak's ~/.var/app/io.github.Amethyst.ModManager/config or in ~/.config; set it only for another location.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_PROJECTS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where projects (mods authored as text) live. Relative paths resolve against the server package. Defaults to the projects folder beside it.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_CK_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The Creation Kit folder, for its Papyrus compiler and vanilla script sources. Defaults to the instance game folder, where Steam installs it.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_PAPYRUS_COMPILER
environmentVariables.description: The Papyrus compiler to use: the Creation Kit's PapyrusCompiler.exe, or russo-2025's papyrus-compiler, which runs on Linux. Defaults to the Creation Kit's on Windows; on Linux, papyrus-compiler on PATH, else tools/papyrus-compiler/papyrus beside the server or in the home folder.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_CRASH_LOG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The folder readCrashLog reads Crash Logger SSE's crash-*.log files from. Defaults to the SKSE folder in the game's My Games folder, where Crash Logger writes them (under Proton, the prefix's).

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_HELPER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The built plugin helper (SkyrimHelper.exe on Windows, SkyrimHelper on Linux). Defaults to the core's helper/bin (node_modules/skyrim-modding-tools-core), where npm run build:helper puts it.

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your personal Nexus Mods API key (nexusmods.com/settings/api-keys), for downloading through Nexus: downloadNexusFile is offered only when Nexus confirms a premium account. searchNexus and readNexusMod need no key. healthcheck shows the account it belongs to. Never share it: Nexus allows personal keys for personal use only.

environmentVariables.name: SKYRIM_ACCEPTED_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP mode only: the bearer tokens callers may present, comma-separated. Unset, HTTP mode accepts nobody.
